description: Learn English and Hindi Inscript typing with guided keyboard lessons, word practice and games. Includes passage practice, timed dictation, exam results, local certificates, display options and keyboard help. Runs locally.
changelog: v21: public-release packaging only - the last-tested declaration is updated to NVDA 2026.2 after the author's own use on NVDA 2026.2, in-package documents are refreshed and the end-sound provenance is finalized (recorded by the author); no functional changes. v20: choosing a game now speaks its rules at once and waits for an explicit Enter, with the rules kept on screen and repeatable via Lesson instructions; a mistyped word comes back once for a twice-correct confirmation with a clear Confirmed announcement, pending confirmations finish before the game ends, and no target is retried forever; punctuation in spoken explanations is never read out as symbol names while target text still speaks every mark you must type; Hindi prompts say svar and matra clearly and name sh, shh and s distinctly; new Hindi chapters cover joined letters, special words and writing your own introduction and letter, with short natural passages closing each drill, and new English lessons cover everyday words, days and dates and guided writing.
